recipe_key.description: Registry key as in plan-marshall (e.g. code-review); at most 37 characters so the recipe plan ID fits the plan_id grammar (identifiers.adoc, recipe_key).

description.description: What the recipe does, shown at the operator's choice.

domain.description: Optional domain; a domain recipe is offered in a project where its domain is active.

pr_title_template.description: Conventional Commit title with {parameter} placeholders bound from recipe_params, rendered deterministically when the recipe's plan is created (recipe.create) into status.metadata.pr_title (phase-workflows.adoc, Plan Source Contracts). An unbound placeholder or a rendered title that fails ConventionalCommitValidator refuses the recipe descriptor at load time.

lane.description: Optional execution-profile seed (posture and per-step overrides), lowest precedence.

parameters_schema.description: Free per-recipe input schema (a JSON Schema 2020-12 object schema) for recipe_params; there is no fixed parameter vocabulary (no global scope x thoroughness matrix). An enum may declare its options server-resolved with x-pm-options (closed set: domains, profiles, skills:<domain>, modules, base_branches). The start's recipe choice validates recipe_params against it and refuses a violation; defaults declared in it are applied by the server. Absent means the recipe takes no parameters and any non-empty recipe_params is refused.

kind.description: request_scoped: no harvest runs; the recipe takes the sources of a request, gathered at the start like a plan's, and its deliverables come from the pre-diagnosed request (named files, root cause, exact change), as for surgical-fix.

project_script_id.description: Key of the enrolled project script (project_scripts of enrolments/<project_id>.json, whose binding must be worker_kind recipe_harvester with this recipe as target); required when kind == 'project_script'.

profile.description: Task profile of the generated deliverables; equals the task profile enum (store-schemas.adoc, Task Record).
